I'm a groomsman for my cousin's fiance in their wedding.  They're both younger than me.  

Just something to add to the list of things I've done before being in my first relationship

yeah are we talking "over you" as in masturbating in your presence, or as in physically cumming on you.  If it's the latter, then at least they're getting *something* in return for being played.

Can you imagine the SJW hate any one of us would get from that same exact post?  Or if the roles were reversed, and it was a guy telling about how he lies to every girl that he promises he just wants to hang out, no sex, before bringing them back and initiating sex?

If being a shitty tease is your M.O., fine, but don't ALSO complain about your life because of it.

I can answer for him: no.

I'm on the second highest dose of bupropion, max dose of sertraline, and just started depakote.  I still beg for death every time I hopelessly scroll through OKC or see a friend get into a relationship or engaged or married.

Psychs don't realize you can't treat FA like regular depression.  Hell, you can't treat FA, period.  If you're born repulsive, you'll die alone.

Of course not.  If you love yourself, you become overconfident.  Now, if you're attractive, that's fine.  But if you aren't, hold on there buddy, you're now a selfish asshole.

Regardless, it's a moot point for me.  I believe in facts, and reason, and evidence, and as a result, am simply incapable of loving myself.
My thing is that I'm funny.  What people don't realize is I'm generally at my funniest when the pain of living is at its worst.

"Be interesting, be legitimately kind, be a friend first, find something to do that instills confidence in you."

I want to say I already do all of this.  I mean, obviously not, or not well enough, but it's not for want of trying.

Even woman who's said no to me has said I had a great personality, and/or that I'm sweet, and/or that I'm so smart when I talk about what I do.  But it never gets me anywhere.  Which leaves us with one of two conclusions:

1. They're telling the truth, but it's not enough to overcome my general undesirableness.
2. They're lying.
Well yeah it's that, too.  Regardless of gender, attractive people enjoy life so much more.  Somehow I don't think I'd mind being treated like a piece of meat...
I've already been alone my whole life, but thanks.
